queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'WinRAR %' AND publisher = 'win.rar GmbH';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'WinRAR %' AND publisher = 'win.rar GmbH' AND version_compare(version, '7.23.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'winrar.exe');
